declared_work: Implement equivalent dashboard plus convergence work in one serialized agent lane with the same dependency, validation, review, publication, and merge boundaries.

observed_window.measurement: earliest child PR creation through latest child PR merge

child_windows.observed_failure: GitHub connector merge returned 403; the already-authorized authenticated UI merge succeeded.
The implementation worker could not spawn its own reviewer; the coordinator supplied the single GPT-5.5 review.

would_have_serialized: review and publication handoff for both surfaces
single_agent_baseline.calculation: 15573 + 425 seconds, summing the two observed child PR lifecycle windows
single_agent_baseline.limitations: This is a conservative serialized lifecycle-window baseline, not a second implementation run. It includes review, CI, merge waiting, and coordination delays and therefore is not a pure coding-time measurement.

comparison.claim: The completed parallel workcell proved safe disjoint execution and serialized integration gates. The measured windows are retained for operational comparison only.
